candidates.title: Rust 1.100 Ships the Never Type After Ten Years and Five Failed Attempts
candidates.excerpt: Rust 1.100.0, released 12 November 2026, stabilises the never type (!) after ten years of work and makes Infallible an alias for it. The release also stabilises the core of the allocator API, adds DropGuard, and gives Cargo an opt-in dependency cooldown setting. Some critics note the allocator design still lacks inline storage support. By Daniel Curtis

candidates.title: AWS Lambda Doubles Its Timeout to 30 Minutes After Eight Years at 15
candidates.excerpt: AWS has raised the maximum timeout of on-demand Lambda Event Functions from 15 to 30 minutes in all commercial regions, with no opt-in and no new pricing. The limit had stood since 2018. AWS's post lists the costs: twice the concurrency at the same request rate, three-hour SQS visibility timeouts, and Kafka mappings that must be recreated. Practitioners welcome it and ask what belongs elsewhere. By Steef-Jan Wiggers
